_comment: Drop this file at a repo root (or any parent dir) to set the guard's enforcement mode for that project tree. The nearest such file walking up from the prompt's cwd wins, unless the INVERITA_GUARD_MODE env var is set (which always overrides). Layer 1 identifiers (SSN/MRN/DOB/etc.) block in every mode; only the broad Layer 2 clinical net is affected.
_comment_mode: "enforce" = block Layer 1 AND Layer 2. "advisory" = block Layer 1, only warn (allow through) on Layer 2. Default when no file/env is present is "advisory".
_comment_shorthand: Alternatively, omit "mode" and set "healthcare": true — that marker is treated as "enforce".
_comment_exceptions: Optional, Layer-2-only allowlist for recurring false positives in THIS project (e.g. a pharmacy app that legitimately discusses doses). Manage with `inverita-guard exceptions add|list|remove` rather than hand-editing this array — the CLI validates the category and requires a reason. Layer 1 identifiers (ssn_pattern/mrn_pattern/dob_name_proximity/email_clinical/insurance_policy) can NEVER be excepted: the guard's read path drops any Layer-1 category found here even if hand-edited in.
